Home.title: Patient care starts with a secure, clear session.
Home.body: The web experience is built against Nabd Plus contracts. Medicines, bookings and coverage are shown only when authorized backend data is available.
Home.safeBody: This foundation separates private data from public content and keeps session tokens out of browser storage.
Home.safetyThree: No synthetic patient or catalog data

Login.title: Patient sign in
Login.body: Credentials are sent through a protected server layer. Tokens are not stored in localStorage.
Login.sandboxNote: Use isolated Sandbox accounts only while testing. Do not enter real patient data in this environment.
Login.invalid: Unable to sign in. Review your details and retry.
Login.unavailable: The service could not be reached. No local fallback session was created.
Login.twoFactor: This session requires additional verification. The verification form will be enabled after its Sandbox DTO is verified.

Dashboard.title: Patient session is protected.
Dashboard.body: Links are available for features that passed their contract and authorization checks. No data is shown before it comes from the authorized backend.

Orders.title: My orders
Orders.empty: There are currently no orders available for this account.
Orders.detailNotice: These details are displayed only from the authorized backend.
Orders.unavailableBody: No fallback data was shown. Please retry later.

Appointments.title: My appointments
Appointments.empty: There are currently no appointments available for this account.
Appointments.detailNotice: Appointment details are displayed only from the authorized backend. Static or synthetic waiting data is not shown.
Appointments.unavailableBody: No fallback data was shown. Please retry later.

Medicines.title: Medicines
Medicines.searchLabel: Search by name or active ingredient
Medicines.empty: No medicines match the current search.
Medicines.detailNotice: This is catalog information from the authorized backend, not a prescription or treatment recommendation. Consult a qualified professional when needed.
Medicines.unavailableBody: No fallback data or price was shown. Please retry later.

Diagnostics.title: Diagnostic bookings
Diagnostics.empty: There are currently no diagnostic bookings available.
Diagnostics.forbidden: You are not allowed to view this section.
Diagnostics.unavailable: This section could not be loaded. No fallback data was shown.
Diagnostics.detailNotice: Only booking status and schedule are displayed from the authorized backend. Reports, documents, and pricing are not displayed in this interface.

HomeCare.title: Home-care bookings
HomeCare.empty: There are currently no home-care bookings available.
HomeCare.unavailable: No fallback data was shown. Please retry later.
HomeCare.notice: Only service, booking status, and schedule are shown. Location, tracking, clinical information, and pricing are not displayed in this interface.

Family.title: Family members
Family.empty: There are currently no family members available.
Family.unavailable: No fallback data was shown. Please retry later.
Family.notice: Only member role and join date are displayed. Identifiers, permissions, health records, and invitations are not displayed in this interface.

Notifications.title: Notifications
Notifications.empty: There are currently no notifications available.
Notifications.unavailable: No fallback data was shown. Please retry later.
Notifications.notice: This is a read-only list. No payload links, read-marking action, device registration, or settings operation is performed from this interface.

Health.title: Vital summary
Health.empty: There are currently no vital readings available.
Health.unavailable: No fallback data was shown. Please retry later.
Health.notice: This section displays recorded readings only and does not provide a diagnosis, alert, or treatment recommendation. Consult a qualified professional for medical care.

Prescriptions.title: Prescriptions
Prescriptions.empty: There are currently no prescriptions available.
Prescriptions.unavailable: No fallback data was shown. Please retry later.
Prescriptions.notice: Only prescription state, item count, and date are shown. Medicine names, doses, diagnoses, and files are not displayed, and this interface provides no dispensing or sending operation.

Profile.title: My health profile
Profile.body: Only fields available from the authorized backend are displayed. No local values are created when data is absent.
Profile.empty: No data is available to display.
Profile.forbidden: You are not allowed to view this section.
Profile.unavailable: This section could not be loaded. No fallback data was shown.

NotFound.title: Page unavailable
NotFound.body: This route cannot be opened or you do not have permission to access it.
